title: Current year tax rates and income brackets (2026)
publisher: Canada Revenue Agency, Government of Canada (canada.ca)
brought_in_because: Section 8(2) of The Income Tax Act, 2000 applies the s. 8(1) bracket thresholds ($45,225 and $129,214) for 2021 on 'subject to the dollar amounts ... being adjusted in accordance with subsection 51(3)', and s. 51(3) indexes by the Consumer Price Index, which is not deposited. The CRA page states the 2026 Saskatchewan thresholds as $54,532 and $155,805. The first is confirmed by s. 3 of The Saskatchewan Low-income Tax Credit Regulations (D = $54,532 - $460/0.03029), whose MB is the s. 8(1)(a) threshold for 2026 (Act s. 39(6.3)).
used_for: the 2026 Saskatchewan bracket thresholds only (lines under '## Provincial or territorial rates for 2026', 'Saskatchewan')
